🔴 highempty_catchCorrectnessfrontend\src\api\stream.ts:72`catch` block is empty — the error is discarded and the program continues

🔴 highswallowed_rejectionCorrectnessfrontend\src\components\AppPaletteSource.tsx:26`.catch(() => {})` discards the error and reports success

🔴 highfloating_promiseCorrectnessfrontend\src\components\CampaignCover.tsx:106`upload(…)` returns a promise that is never awaited or handled
→ Await it, return it, or attach a `.catch`. A floating promise runs out of order and its rejection becomes an unhandled rejection (a hard crash under Node's default in v15+).
